description:
The ReqView example project is open showing the SRS (Software Requirements Specification) document. Export the SRS document to CSV format and save the output file to /home/ga/Documents/srs_export.csv.

The project has a pre-configured export named 'SRS document to CSV' available in the export menu. The exported file must exist at exactly /home/ga/Documents/srs_export.csv when the task is complete.
